# Ezekiel 7 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 7:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | An-end has-come! The-end has-come! It-has-awakened against-you — behold, it-comes! |
| LOGOS | An end has come; the end has come; it has awakened against you. Behold, it comes. |
| PNEUMA | The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Here it comes! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

## 7:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |

| EMET | Behold the-day! Behold it-comes! The-doom has-gone-forth, the-rod has-blossomed, the-arrogance has-budded. |
| LOGOS | Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has come; the rod has blossomed; pride has budded. |
| PNEUMA | Look! The day is here! Doom has arrived! Wickedness has blossomed. Arrogance is in full bloom. |

## 7:20 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-beauty-of his-ornament — for-majesty he-set-it; and-images-of their-abominations, their-detestable-things, they-made in-it; therefore I-have-made-it to-them an-unclean-thing. |
| LOGOS | His beautiful ornament they used for pride, and they made their abominable images and their detestable things of it. Therefore I make it an unclean thing to them. |
